game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Rope Walk, the rope-makers' walk: the sailor must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Priority Alert: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs.
theme: Coastal Port – Rope Walk: the rope-makers' walk
core_gameplay_loop: In Rope Walk, repeat each round: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs. Each round, jellyfish swarms strike the harbor bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the alert_accuracy value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the harbor bell from jellyfish swarms in Rope Walk: keep the alert_accuracy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: alert_accuracy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 8 (extended tier): Priority Alert
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Priority Alert' (Week 3 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Rope Walk'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert_accuracy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Rope Walk.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while alert_accuracy > 0.
